title: Keynote reveal
when: Product reveals, feature launches and specs worth celebrating: one object, lit on a dark stage

voice.style: confident, warm and precise, like a keynote presenter

rules: A dark stage and one hero object, drawn: a few ellipses and gradients make a lit product (see the ring in product-reveal). Light it (a beam from above, rim light, a reflection, a contact shadow) rather than decorating around it.
Reveal in pieces, then the whole: the object arrives as a line of light, a macro close-up glides along an edge, then the camera pulls back to the object and its name.
Specs arrive as inserts: one huge number with its unit and what it is compared with, ideally the comparison drawn (two bars, two times). Every figure carries a visible source line.
Type sits in the negative space beside the object, never over it. Nothing under 34 px; one accent colour, used only on what is new.
End on the object and the name, with a light sweep, and one line of availability in the same shot.
